```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            c( "Hif1a", "Matn4"),
            split.by = "sample.name",
            reduction = "umap.nn",
            pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&
  RestoreLegend()
```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$Matn4_data <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data["Matn4",]
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::GroupCorrelation(
  mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
  assay   = "SCT",
  var     = "Matn4_data",
  slot    = "data",
  do.plot = FALSE
  )
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@meta.features %>% head
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@meta.features %>% View
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,c( "Hif1a", "Matn4", "Bcl2l1", "Meg3", "Cd14")  ,split.by = "sample.name",reduction = "umap.nn",pt.size = 0.1, order = T)&scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()
```

```{r}
hif1a_expr <- as.numeric(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data["Hif1a", ])

x <- correlate_features_to_covariate(
  mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data,
  hif1a_expr,
  method = "spearman"
)
```

```{r}
hif1a_expr <- as.numeric(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data["Hif1a", ])

x <- correlate_features_to_covariate(
  mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["SCT"]]@data,
  hif1a_expr,
  method = "kendall",
  features = VariableFeatures(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
)
```
